text: it's okay. it's a great game at first and I really enjoyed it. the higher level you go, the more it's all about them making money. you have to pay for coins to play - the cost per game increases, the daily free coin rewards decrease and, for many of the later levels, you will need to spend coins whilst playing just to finish a level on wildcards etc. it's fun, but I'd uninstall after a while as it becomes a bit of a moneymaking scam after that.

Don't waste your time, or money. The game seems fun at first, but as you progress, the cost to play in "game coins" increases significantly, but the rewards for winning, which seems suspiciously over difficult, are incredibly low. You can buy helps, but these become ridiculously expensive. I did actually buy some game coins, but these did not last long, due to the huge imbalance between cost to play and rewards for winning the hand. They push the in-app purchases a lot. Would give -5 if poss.

It is a total cashgrab. When I first installed it, things were going fine. However, the prices of the levels went up quick, and the only profit I made from a level was around 300 coins. The cards slots are horrible, and even after purchasing 5 more cards (with in game coins) I still couldnt get a good card. I made a purchase for 40000 coins, but that went down the drain quickly. I purchased 13000 more coins today, but that vanished in like 5 minutes. It is clear that the game is a total scam.

The game has some interesting twists but unfortunately like many games it is just rigged and money grabbing. Once you play a few hundred levels it is easy to notice a pattern. No matter how well you play the amount of times you can have 6 or 7 cards left and it never manages to be the card you need is ridiculously high. The game takes advantage of this if competing in events. I have reached level 700 and over 50 times it has taken me 25 cards to get the 1 I need, paying for 5 cards at a time.

Beta tester: The theme's are enchanting. I'm on the Aladdin one at the moment in time. This game as a few problems. The hourly daily coins are far two low for saving up to at least 50 thousand or more to play. Most of the level's are easy to play. Most times I use the gold card to finish off a level. Most of theme items I need to finish off that theme go higher and higher in coins like 15 coins. finishing off the theme for the next theme can be highly frustrating.

At the beginning it was fun but now it feels like they just want me to spend money. At least 7 pop ups appear encouraging spending before you even get to the game then you only get enough free coins for one chance at a round so if you lose you have to wait an hour before the next set of free coins appear which is ridiculous! Definitely not something I plan to continue using

I love the aspect of the game. I dislike the fact that it's pay-to-win on such a high scale. It forces your hand with cards that aren't needed, so you have to keep buying cards to pass the level. The packages are all different prices, but the coins don't last long as the cards you have are never the cards you need, so you have to buy more cards. There's not enough time to complete challenges unless you're willing to pay a lot of money. A shame, really, for those who prioritize their finances.

great game at first. the visuals are vibrant and stunning. the game is smooth, and its somewhat addictive, BUT.....gold coins are scarce and playing matches drains your gold coins rapidly. I'm only on stage 4, and it costs 4,200 just to play regularly (even with a free play token, it says "free play + 2,100 gold coins"....making the free play token completely irrelevant!!!!). I started a match with 31,781 gold coins, and after I completed it, I had only 10,000 gold coins left. please fix pricing

Don't bother. Utterly useless unless you pay for lots of virtual coins, as they only give you enough free for 1 level per hour and a small amount when you finish a level that is less than it often costs to finish. So rigged that the cards you need always turn up once you've paid for five extra cards. If you don't claim your free coins every hour, you can't earn any more until you do. Each scene requires a lot of completed levels to finish. The Disney theme is cute and fun.

Just so you know before trying this game it is built to take money. We all know the modern world but dont think you could beat these levels without spending. It pulls you in, as all games do and then offers the best deal for £1. after that you get further and get invested but if you get stuck you will wait for 1 or 2 days before you beat that lvl especially if you try to do it for free or by using an app that pays cashback. I'm just being honest, as most games on here are, its rigged.

you should be able.to complete albums got to 98% twice and first time I even "bought" card still never got there! so no reward for you even when you put money in, believe it should reward you for regular play, I'm on level 1226 and seriously thinking of deleting it again also the amount of in store purchase banners is getting ridiculous, you have to keep clicking then to get even to play the game, there's never just one. also they happen between levels sort it out

Pretty much the same feelings as everyone else.. love the gameplay, the graphics etc but it's rubbish how few coins you get every hour, it literally just wants you to buy coins with no chance at a good long gameplay session before they run out. I don't mind spending a few £ here and there to enhance it but not just to be able to play the basics, will be deleting shortly I think which is a shame as I really enjoy it 😔

I was initially impressed with this game and rated it higher, but the more i play, the more i realise that its all money-driven. I find myself constantly playing for coins and deals which runs out within what feels like seconds. You would think that paying £20 to get access to a mini side game thats limited for 3-4 days, would give you unlimited access to it for 3-4 days even if you win the final prize. But turns out you would have to pay another £20 just to play it again😂 just laughable.

This "game" sucks, its so obviously rigged for you to lose in-game coins to the point where you are forced to purchase them to keep playing. As you progress, things in the game get more and more expensive, and you get less and less back each time you play. Giving the player absolutely no incentive to keep going. Its no wonder they're trying to pay people to play this. I'd rate 0 stars if I could.

You progress through the first few levels easily, gathering coins and feeling like you're better than anyone else. Why would you ever need to pay for coins?! Then, after completing a few worlds, the cost of everything goes up and you find yourself taking fewer risks and eventually getting to a point where you need coins to progress. At that point, I uninstalled. I think Disney has enough of my money already. I'm not paying to play this game.

could have been a good casual game to pass some time if the developers weren't so greedy. started ok but very quickly becomes a pay to play game, nearly every level is designed to be a no win situation unless you have been buying content regularly. having a Disney theme is also largely aimed at taking advantage of young players. in my opinion.

What a greedy, greedy game this is. You can barely ever actually play it past level 100, when you inevitably run out of coins. each level requires more coins to start, and the amount the helps cost rises by insane amounts, and you only get enough every hour to play once. disgusting and greedy, what a way to ruin a fun game.

buggy and useless on level 300+ keeps freezing have reinstalled, cleared memory and cache. pressing on icons doesn't work. when I do manage to play and win the game freeze so my win isn't registered. spent loads on this in the hopes of winning a level and money with free cash and now it's all gone to waste. A complete waste of time. it's not my phone I have enough free memory and other games work. phones is a pixel 7 so not super old. Don't invest your time on this, you'll only be disappointed

good fun untill it isn't anymore. saying it's typical Disney and a cash cow is like saying nothing. An idea is good, not a bad graphic , colorful animations all great. unfortunately, very, very shortly you realise, without microtransactions you aren't going to progress, because each time you about to finish a quest, a magically cards aren't there , you "pay" via coins to get another 5 , nothing z then another 5 and still not even one. rigged more than candy crush

great game and enjoy being all the characters and completing missions, but game isn't designed at all for free to play, you can play to level 97 for free, after that, with no payment you wont get passed that level unless you wait hours for the free bonus and buy extra cards, enjoyed playing until level 97, got bored after trying to be made to play to win

soft locked after level 100 as the levels are very hard to clear with pure luck without using items which costs progressively more money. shame as the game is fun but not worth it unless you're ready to open your wallet. NOT f2p last edit: 2/3 days later I've actually uninstalled the game. not worth your time if instead of enjoying the game it simply becomes frustrating. if you read this review, just don't install it. not worth your time

It's a good game don't get me wrong and it even helps me to relax but I can only play 4 or 5 levels before my coins run out. I don't want to keep spending money either. Also you have to make sure you have enough coins to pay that particular level too.if it wasn't for this flaw I would give 5 stars because I love Disney amd it's part of my childhood but because you have to use in game coins per level I'm only giving 3 stars thankyou.

Really badly designed. Made so the you have to spend far to much in game currency more often that not meaning you make a loss most levels and so you have have to wait for the very small hourly top-ups which you have to keep logging in to get a decent store of currency to keep you going, or making you want to spend real money in order to progress.

this game extremely money focused you can complete any of the albums or other events without paying too much money no matter how much you pay you don't get the reward you need to complete things. The levels also become impossible to win without using your coins to buy extra cards after which you use all yours coins on one level and can't play more with purchaseing more or waiting long time to build more up not worth playing

If you had more chances to make money and actually win levels it would be the perfect game. But the game is clearly setup so you spend money on coins. Should be done with a set amount of lives rather than playing once and then waiting 2 hours to have enough money to play with again.

A relaxing game destroyed by Dev greed. Sad to see Disney team up with the same curtains as in Dominoes Dreams. No free game worthy of note as constant harvesting required. Paid game will see you buying out levels when on X2 or 4 at about twice the cost of the game. Best to stay on X1 Peaceful relaxing solitaire here becomes more about how long your credits will last. In my case £14... approx 2 x 90 min sessions. To sum up....2 sessions and I'm uninstalling now.

although the game is fun at times I do have some issues, the first of these is how little profit you can actually make from the levels as if you manage to do it without having to pay for any extra powers then you earn about 10% profit which is nothing as any powers will cost more than that and cause you to go on negatives and the second is how you can get the same card or cards several times in a row when drawing making it impossible to keep playing and forcing a loss.

If you're here from freecash thinking you can complete some offers, It will cost you more than youre paid. When it decides your win streak is done, you can go through 10 cards with only 1 card left without getting the one you need. I guess thats card games but its frustrating when it costs so many coins to play a game, the perks are even more expensive and the rewards for winning a level is barely a 10% profit. All rigged towards you having to buy coins to play, they dont even hide it

same as everyone else. really like the gameplay but as I'm progressing more I'm loosing interest because unless I spend loads of money I can't actually play much. not sure how much longer it'll have me hooked before I forget it's on my phone due to not being able to play more than one or two rounds.

I lowered my rating as the game doesn't even try to hide the fix and the charges for what you get returned are ridiculous. The cost of cards in your game is just stupid and being charged just as much to play a single game of solitaire as you get for winning a game or that you get as an hourly bonus is crazy. The game would be far better with a more balanced reward system for winning so if you win you get to play two or three more hands rather than oh you lost well that's you done then.

Great game in terms of design, playability and feel but it quickly gets to the point where you cant play unless you put serious money into it. I bought a couple of packs and it helped a little but the end result is the same you have to pay to progress and it has very little to do with skill or strategy.

The app will not open. It crashed at the end of a completed game so I don't know if I got the stars or not. Can this be fixed please. Considering you have to pay money to play it should not be crashing. I have cleared cache restarted my phone and it still the same. The app will not open. Ridiculous!

I really love this game BUT.... since the latest update costs have increased significantly. I watch lots of videos to gain coins and free cards etc. however the devs in their drive for more cash have decided to watch the full movie night you now have to pay real cash to continue watching videos... are they insane!!! im sorry but that's a step to far and I will be deleting the game, never to return again. I have never played such a cash grab game before!!!! Come on devs sort it out!!!

agree with other reviews. It's a heavily money driven app. No option to earn money for more rounds unless you purchase more coins. Shame really as the concept of the game, graphics are all there, but extremely let down by the fact you can't get far with levels unless you pay.

The gameplay is fun and easy to pick up and play. However the game wants you to spend money, a LOT of money. Making a £20 purchase will maybe get you a days worth of play. If you don't want to pay money you get one game per hour and most of the time that feels rigged to make you lose unless you spend money on extra cards. This is a game that could actually do with having ads to earn extra coins or extra cards to complete games.

It was a good game but suddenly the game became un-responsive (I was at the Cinderella stage). I have tried clearing the cache and storage and yet still the same. I don't think reinstalling the game is an option for me. I have reached out to the team to have it fixed, and they were so quick about it. I appreciate it, will edit to 5 stars later if my achievements weren't affected with all the clearing storage stuff that I have done.

Complete con of a game. The game play itself is really fun and the first couple of scenes you think "yeah, this is a great game". But as you go on, the game is clearly rigged to make you lose the in-game coins in order to get you to spend money. If run out of coins, the ads come at you relentlessly to spend. The coins regenerate once an hour, but you have to collect them each hour. If you forget, they don't add multiple hours, it's just that one hour. Just don't even bother.

it gets 1 star only, and that is because I like the gameplay. its a massive money grab wanting you to spend money and progress. the special tasks are ridiculous, needing a stupid amount of wins in a row. you wait an hour for enough coins for just one level. its all very much geared up to make you spend money. oh, and as a side note, the invites don't work and you don't get your coins.

I've never been so glad to finally dump this app. 7 exit crosses just to play a level or collect your hours bonus. every single time I entered this game it has in-app pop-ups, 7 in-app pop-ups. what a joke of a game. Then don't even start me on the game play itself. For a solitaire game I genuinely enjoy, I'll still never download this again. money, money, money!! what a rip.

I'd love to be able to give this 5 stars as it's an addictive and fun game. Unfortunately it's let down by its relentless greed for your money. Games are evidently rigged to frequently leave you with just one card giving you the choice of either losing the game or buying more and more coins just to keep going - and this can soon add up if you're not careful.

The amount of ads to buy,buy,buy is insane. Cannot even start playing without having to close 6 different pop ups. Game itself is simple, but also focused to mine money, intentionaly blocking You from passing some levels until You spend some in-game currency or wait... real money. Kills time, but at what cost.

It's an ok game, but after the first 80 to 100 levels, your money starts to go down, and it's really hard to gain it back just by playing. you need to spend your own money to get more coins to play. All the events, etc, are practically impossible unless you have continuous wins, which never happens, really. if you're not willing to spend your own money, then you're going to really struggle. in game helps are a lot of coins too so its hard to complete levels first time for win streaks.

As others have said, the game starts brilliantly. However, once you reach a certain point it is impossible to play and the enjoyment is completely taken away. It costs too much to play a level, which most of the time you lose. Then you can't play another level for an hour when the reward regenerates. This also makes it impossible to complete any of the extra tasks, such as the puzzle pieces as you can never collect enough of them, as you never have the coins to play the more rewarding levels

frustrating. quite clearly a 'pay to play' game. initial premise was good but the further you go, the more annoying it is to have to wait for coins. and Disney, please do something about the sounds, I mute my games so I can listen to music, and I have to keep muting this every time as it turns the sounds on when I go back to it. it might seem minor, bug it's really annoying.

At first, it's fun. Progressing through the early levels (up to around level 80) is smooth and rewarding. However, once you get further, it becomes obvious that the game is designed to pressure players into buying coins. The odds feel heavily stacked against you, regularly only needing 1 more card to pass a level. If you wait for the free coins to refresh, the game will allow you to complete a level or two. It stops being fun and more about how much you're willing to spend.

I love Disney and I enjoy this type of Solitaire game. I like that you can decorate and recreate memorable Disney scenes by passing levels. It's just unfortunate that as you progress it costs so much to play each level. The in-game coins that you earn go towards playing a level and using any aids you might need, but the cost goes up and you can't seem to earn enough back to continue playing. And if you lose a level even a couple of times, you run out of coins to progress and you're stuck.

Don't let kids play, far too pushy to spend money on in-app purchases, sometimes 7+ popups as you open the app, a child would accidentally spend lots of money very quickly. The game itself is okay initially, then the cost of playing is just stupid, you can easily lose 100,000+coins each level, I've lost over 200,000 in one game. Higher levels are impossible to earn enough coins in the game to continue without paying too often. Plus it feels like a reskin of other games with Disney characters.

Absolutely love the game and the graphics. I look forward to creating new scenes especially of the movies I love. The BIG downside... game play is rigged, spend too many in-game coins for levels and in-game support, quickly run out of currency, don't receive enough coins each hour to play a level. Takes ages to progress in levels, bonus games are over too quickly to achieve anything. So much potential but sorry no more purchases from me.

The game is almost completely geared towards monetisation, in an exploitative way. You need to pay coins to play a game, if you win, you win slightly more than you paid to play, and if you need to use any bonuses during a game, that costs way more than playing a game. The model is to get you to play, try to encourage addiction to the game, then make it impossible to play without spending money. Awful

Good time sink, but every time you open the app you get confronted with 3-4 different screens of "offers" to buy in-game currency and rewards. Of course it's completely optional to purchase these, but you can tell the game's primary purpose is to suck cash from you. Not every level is winnable first time, due to the "random" nature, but it has that claw machine brand of randomness where it feels like the game has decided you can't win this one so try again in an hour or pay more money.

Shocking!! Absolute cash grab and pay to win!! Level 1 to 30 let's you earn around 30,000 coins with ease but from level 40 onwards, the game strategically makes you lose and you have to use all your coins to pass a level. Forcing you into a position where the only way you can progress is either wait a ridiculously long time or spend real money. I expected so much better from Disney, but just like any other game here, it's all about the money and less about user enjoyment. DO BETTER!!

good game. I was enjoying it. Once you start hitting level 70+ you don't get enough coins to even attempt another level. so you end up waiting 2 hours for one turn that will probably fail. it's a strange system that DOES NOT WORK. most apps of this type have 5 lives that refresh over time giving you more than 1 attempt on a level. this app needs to adapt this method. so just the 2 stars from me as it's simply unplayable (Unless you purchase coins).

This game is a cash grab. Lures you in with quirky graphics and the first few levels are genuinely quite fun for a pocket game. Quite soon it becomes clear that you MUST spend real money to advance. The rewards are paltry and it very quickly costs more coins to complete a level than you earn in rewards for completing it. The fact that the cost to play a level and the cost of using items scales up all the time through the levels means you're never building coins but slowly/quickly depleting them.

loving the game, and the scene contents. not really a true solitaire, more like a dominoes style game with cards, but it's cute and has a few different aspects for challenges. one thing I would say the developers could consider, would be to have the ability to match a card with another, e.g. you draw an ace and there is one on the board so you can put one ace on top of another. perhaps it could be something you could win or gain as another option, like the rewind option.

This game is alright It's fun to play but it does get repetitive sometimes. there isn't much of a challenge for example every 5 levels 4 of them will be easy to complete making the 5 really difficult not challenging, difficult this can be annoying when you run out of coins leaving you wait until you get more or forced to buy coins if you are a paid to play player. the events are cool and I like the stickers you can unlock.

Visually impressive with top-tier animation, characters, and audio. However, the constant barrage of monetisation prompts—sometimes up to seven in a row—quickly diminishes the experience. The need to check in hourly just to earn enough coins for brief gameplay becomes frustrating. What prompted this review, though, was the recent change making stickers time-limited—an update that feels both misleading and unfair.

I started out really enjoying this game, loved earning stars to build up the Disney scenes. I purchased a couple of packs with real money and starting winning the majority of the games but as soon as I stopped paying, I noticed I was losing all of the time and was no longer progressing. the Winnie the pooh competition is impossible to complete because when you get near the top, no matter what you pretty much lose. it is such a shame that this game is only playable when you pay money.

This is a good game idea, but it takes a stupid amount of levels to finish each scenes. I am on level 350 and not even finished scene 8. The amount of stars for each scene needs to be revised and lowered a lot to make this more fun. Also it costs a ridiculous amount of coins to ppay each level. Yes you get the amount for a level once per hour but it makes this unplayable for extended periods of time and is not enjoyable.

This game would be great but its just unplayable. While you can collect coins every hour it isn't enough to play one level. Daily coins are ok and you can have about 10 minutes in the game when you first log in, however they are not consistent with how many they give, one day i could get 9000 the next 19000. Unless you remember to log in every hour and save the coins up then you just can't play unless you spend real money. Such a shame because it would be a great game otherwise.

excellent game visually and the idea behind it but it's a massive cash grab! there is not enough gold income at all to keep playing unless you spend cash on the game! The events are even worse... because there is no guarantee to win each level you play... it's all about luck of the draw and if you get no luck, you cannot progress them.

The amount of real money you are trying to get from people is shocking. It might seem optional to spend real money, but without spending real money you'll basically be unable to play much. You can play like 1 game every couple of hours, run out of coins then bring up tons of ways to use real cash to get coins to play. There needs to be a balance, but this way is not fun. It should be labeled as a gambling app and regulated.

Game play is actually good and addictive. The problem is that this game is basically gambling. You have to pay coins to play a game, but as it's all luck based, if you get a bad streak then that match becomes unwinnable and you have to spend more coins or give up the coins you spent to play and forfeit. You get free coins every hour but only enough for one game. Events can also pay out coins, but unless you have enough to play with, then it's useless.

I really enjoyed this game to begin with but it was clear to see that once you have got used to the levels, they purposely make you lose so you spend your real money just to play a level. I have stupidly done this and managed to play around 3 levels before you have to spend again. This is just a money making game, which is so disappointing because it has so much potential.

When I first downloaded this game it was great. I had loads of coins so could easily progress but the further I got the more I noticed you had to use coins to open and play levels. Never seen a game do this before meaning if you have to replay a level a few times to win it costs a lot of coins meaning you run out very quickly. I don't see the logic in paying to play levels. Paying to get assistance in levels if your stuck possibly just not to open levels. Ruined the game for me.

I completely agree with the other reviews. I love the game but it is sadly rigged for in app purchase. The hourly coins are not enough to keep the game playing especially as in some levels you have to use coins to complete the game. It is sad as its a really enjoyable solitare format and the graphics are great! Its just whether you are happy to constantly be funneling money into a game, which sadly I am not.

This app is so frustrating it's basically unplayable! The economy of the game is the most ridiculous I've ever seen, the in game boosts cost 2-3x as much as it costs to start a game, and the rewards are so low you can hardly play. When you are playing it feels rigged against you, sometimes I have one card left on my board and I click through TEN OR MORE cards in the deck and still don't have a playable one. I get that you want to make money, but this game is a sadistic capitalist nightmare.

Initially I was really enjoying this game but as you progress it goes from being fun to being downright frustrating. Whilst there is some shred of skill involved, this game is purely luck based and rigged against you. it requires more and more coins to progress, always encouraging you to spend actual money for in-game currency! I wish I could continue with this game but its just became so infuriating and no longer any fun. Good concept, greedily poor execution! What a shame!

Enjoying the game so far, especially in it's early stages. feel like there should be more way to earn more coins or reduced prices for the abilities. some sort of team option might be fun to interact with friends abit more. I have invited atleast 2 friends using the link share and only received 1. I have now hit a point where I can only attempt a level once per hour which is making me lose interest and my opinion on the game is quickly deteriorating.

Starts off fun, but gets increasingly impossible after around level 70. You can claim coins once an hour but these are only enough for one game at 1x rewards, and each level will take multiple attempts to beat because the cards are so unfair. Most of the time you have no chance to beat a level at all with the cards you're given. Wildcards and extra cards are outrageously expensive too so you can never use them. This is a blatant cash grab disguised as a cutesy Disney game.

Good game but progression is unfair. Either keep the cost of undo, extra cards and wild card at lower coin values, or remove the coin cost of initiating a level attempt. Coins are used for everything and you don't get enough of them later in the game to make any progress unless you get extremely lucky. If you want people to play and spend money you need to make it possible to continue playing F2P normally. Right now you're going to have a lot of people dropping off around level 90 or so.

Game tweaks the solitaire mechanism enough to be enjoyable. Continuous play would get expensive because each level of progress sees the cost to play ramp up. This took the shine off it for me and I didn't enjoy playing enough to buy into the usual in-app-purchase mechanisms, leaving me cynical about true randomness vs. motivation to generate revenue.

Could be really good, however, pop ups are so frequent you are clicking away before you can even play. Pay so many coins to play a round is a bit annoying especially because if you do win the round you only get a few hundred more than it costs to play so the coins you get back are minimal. Not only that but if you need to undo a turn, add more cards, place a wild card it costs way more. You end up spending more time to get the coins back only to lose them in seconds on one game.Not very balanced

Good fun Solitaire Story Type game, with a Disney theme twist. No ability to replay earlier levels which means if you run out of, or low on, coins, you cannot farm lower levels to keep yourself in the game you are forced to close the game and come back later once free coins have regenerated (timer based mechanic). Social page also doesn't offer free rewards if links clicked.

This game would be really cool if playable ...WITHOUT the need for having to spend in app purchasing to ACTUALLY be able to play the game fully! 100% agree with the other reviews it's so rigged in that way. Not enough chances/choices as the levels are beyond ridiculous to complete without having to pay, I find this really greedy of the app developers and because of this i am so close to deleting it as its just frustrating, pointless, long, and boring under these circumstances .

Pay to win game, bo chance to complete levels when you only get enough to play once every hour. Worst part of the game is the wild cards at 5000+ coins, if you accidentally hit that with you finger (which I've done 3 times!) A skip back or 5 extra cards is more than it costs to play the levels, totally not worth playing or even spending your money on

This started as a fun game when you first download it and the music is great, but once you get further in you can only seem to win the first game of the day after you've collected your daily bonus. After that the cards are rigged so you're left with 1 or 2 cards to try to make you purchase more coins to continue playing. The seemly endless popups when you open the game are also really annoying.

Yes, purchasing is optional but it quickly gets to the point where you can't play more than a game and hour without paying. so, paying is optional only in the sense that playing is optional. if you're happy spending an increasing amount of money to play, it's a slick professional game. but it is carefully designed to encourage you to spend. this isn't a game to give to a child no matter how cute it looks.

Enjoyed the experience I had but was severely disappointed when I realised I couldn't continue playing on the 3rd scene due to lack of funds, with my options being to wait and tap into the game every hour to return the funds or alternatively buy more, which is not worth it as the prices increase very largely with every scene. Uninstalled. :(

I really enjoyed this game initially but now it's just frustrating. It's incredibly predatory with money - with most of the rewards requiring some sort of financial buy-in in order to get all the prizes. What's worse is that the more levels I completed the more artifical game overs the game introduced. I'm over 2000 levels in and just lost a game despite having 10+ cards in my draw pile and only 1 card left on the board. This happens all the time now.

Starts off great - but very quickly becomes expensive to pass levels. After levels 40-50 (which you progress to pretty quick), they start changing levels so that you don't get the cards to finish. You'll pull out the same card that you can't match 3 or 4 times in a row, meaning you have to use your coins to finish a level (which starts off at 100coin and quickly progresses to 3k or 4k) You'll go through your coins quick in an attempt to make you buy more. Uninstalled!
